name: ablign
description: Ableton Live extension that aligns vocal doubles and backing takes to your lead vocal.
author: Zo-Le-Dedrui

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && tsx tools/dialog-check.ts && tsx tools/safety-check.ts && tsx build.ts --production
scripts.build:dev: tsc --noEmit && tsx tools/dialog-check.ts && tsx tools/safety-check.ts && tsx build.ts
scripts.package: npm run build && tsx tools/activate-check.ts && ableton-extensions-cli package
scripts.check: tsx tools/align-check.ts && tsx tools/sibilant-check.ts && tsx tools/quality.ts && tsx tools/dialog-check.ts && tsx tools/safety-check.ts && tsx tools/activate-check.ts
